findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: public-post, public-posts · Private data: request-discovery-call · Public sink: public-post, request-discovery-call.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: public-post, public-posts · Private data: request-discovery-call · Public sink: public-post, request-discovery-call

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
